researcher_notes: Opus full-redo pass. FIVE source files, all confirmed STILL from the last-page imprint (Berzeliusstraße 10, 22113 Hamburg): (1) `iGo_systems_DE_TD.pdf` — 18 pp, 'STILL iGo Technische Daten', the only file with real VDI 2198 Typenblätter; covers EXV iGo, FM-X iGo (5 variants), MX-X iGo (3 configurations) plus full mast tables. (2) `AXL-iGo_DE_Brochure.pdf` — 8 pp, single-product brochure for the AXL iGo truck loader. (3) `AGV-Overview_DE_Flyer.pdf` — 2 pp, a portfolio comparison MATRIX across 8 model lines (payload / lift height / speed / dual operation) — the single densest page in the group. (4) `Automation_DE_Brochure.pdf` — 15 pp, FTS overview; its p.9 introduces FIVE industry-specific iGo models that exist in none of the other files and in none of the DB. (5) `Intralogistic-Systems_DE_Brochure.pdf` — 15 pp, mostly MANUAL trucks; only its Routenzug/Schmalgang pages are relevant, and its 18 m / 14 km/h MX-X figures describe the MANUAL MX-X, not MX-X iGo — deliberately not mapped. The group's dominant finding is that STILL's own four documents disagree with each other on several headline figures; every such case is recorded with both values and both citations rather than resolved. Nothing written to Airtable.

LIFT HEIGHT — no conflict proposed, but three different numbers exist across STILL's own files and the DB holds a fourth-hand version of one of them: `iGo_systems_DE_TD.pdf` p.6 mast table gives 'Hub h3 mm 2844 / 3244 / 3744' with 'Einlagerhöhe 2780 / 3180 / 3680'; `Automation_DE_Brochure.pdf` p.8 says 'bis 3.744 mm'; `AGV-Overview_DE_Flyer.pdf` p.1 and `iGo_systems_DE_TD.pdf` p.9 body both say 3.800 mm / '3,8 Metern'. Flagged as an ACCURACY note, not a conflict — but if lifting_height is used for K.O. matching, 3800 will admit a tender that the machine cannot actually serve. PAYLOAD DERATING — best artefact in this group: `iGo_systems_DE_TD.pdf` p.7 prints a 'Grundtragfähigkeiten' load chart (payload on the y-axis 0–2000 kg vs. 'Hubhöhe in mm' on the x-axis 0–4000), with TWO curves for fork-tine thickness s = 55 mm and s = 71 mm, and the explicit caption 'Dieses Diagramm gibt an, für welche Lasten und Regalhöhen das automatisierte Fahrzeug zuverlässig, reproduzierbar und sicher Ladungen transportieren und ein- bzw. auslagern kann.' AP0 stores a single max_payload (1600 kg) and cannot express either the height derate or the fork-thickness axis. Recurring finding, now 6+ instances. AP0 SCOPE ASYMMETRY (recurring): p.8 'Großer Touchscreen auf Augenhöhe unterstützt die Nutzenden – für intuitive Bedienung' and p.9 'Benutzerschnittstelle (Display) mit Touchscreen-Bildschirm' — `onboard_ui` is AMR-scope only, so a forklift AGV with a documented operator HMI cannot store it. Left null (not written to an out-of-scope field). AP0 GAP (recurring, now 10+): p.6 row '4.35 Wenderadius im manuellen Modus Wa mm 1744' — an explicit RADIUS label (safe to map under the established rule) but Forklift scope has no turning-radius field. not_imported_flagged.name: OPX-L 20 S iGo neo

not_imported_flagged.recommendation: Do NOT import as an AGV/AMR product. This is an OPERATOR-FOLLOWING order picker (STILL's 'iGo neo' semi-autonomous line), not a driverless transport vehicle: it requires a human walking alongside and its function is to follow them. Creating a Mobile AMR row for it would let it match driverless-transport tenders it cannot serve. Recorded here so the model is not simply lost. Note the same file also names 'iGo pilot' (assisted driving) and 'iGo cube' (a plug-and-play pallet shuttle store) — neither is a vehicle in the AP0 sense either.
